title: Group Robust Preference Optimization in Reward-free RLHF
benchmark_measurement: Aligning an LLM's preferences with the diverse opinions of different national groups on various topics, including religion, as captured in the GlobalOpinionQA dataset.
findings: The paper's findings are not specifically about religion. The proposed method, GRPO (Group Robust Preference Optimization), was shown to better align a language model (Gemma-2B) to the preferences of the worst-performing groups (in this case, countries) on the GlobalOpinionQA dataset. This dataset includes questions on religion, among other topics, meaning the method helps create a more equitable alignment across national groups on subjects that can include religious viewpoints, but no specific findings about religious content were reported.
